verdict.rationale: Fly.io's own docs say a single `fly launch` run from the project source directory will "create, configure, and (for most apps) deploy a new application." It also generates a Dockerfile for popular frameworks, so one CLI command covers setup through deploy. Missing for 10: scaffolding of new application source code (fly launch works on an existing source directory and only generates config and a Dockerfile), automatic deployment for every app rather than "most apps", and independent hands-on corroboration of the `fly launch` flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scaffold and deploy a new project with a single CLI command

citations.quote: Run `fly launch` from inside your project source directory to create, configure, and (for most apps) deploy a new application.
No Dockerfile? No problem: we'll generate one for most popular frameworks, including Rails, Phoenix, Django, Node, Laravel, Go, Rust, .NET and more.
Ship from GitHub or our CLI with `fly launch`.
